cohort: The participants were pregnant women in Ibadan, Nigeria, whose data were sourced from the Ibadan Pregnancy Study (IbPCS).
finding: Maternal obesity, which was prevalent at 19.3%, was associated with maternal age, parity, and income, and directly increased the risk of adverse pregnancy outcomes, including macrosomia, caesarean section, birth asphyxia, and GDM.
mod_finding: Maternal obesity increased the relative risk of caesarean section by 1.41 (95% CI: 1.09 - 1.81).
